diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a deterministic sequence: wait for temp > 28, turn on, wait 15 MIN, then turn off. The candidate incorrectly adds a conditional check before turning off. F1 shows the temperature input is null during the 15-minute delay, causing the candidate's guard to fail. F2 confirms the IR executed switch_off at 900000ms while the candidate emitted nothing. F3 lines 4-6 show the erroneous if block.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the conditional 'if' block surrounding switch_off. The IR executes the off action unconditionally after the delay, regardless of the sensor state.
